articles.title: Bitcoin diverges from South Korean stocks as AI concerns deepen the Kospi selloff
articles.description: South Korea’s chipmakers lead another sharp selloff as concerns over AI spending and Chinese competition grow, while bitcoin holds well above its summer lows.

articles.title: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K
articles.description: The proposal would require crypto owners to report holdings over €100,000, sparking concerns following a wave of "wrench attacks" in France.

articles.title: Metaplanet to issue $329M convertible bonds to pay debt, fund share buybacks
articles.description: Metaplanet plans to issue zero-interest bonds with a five-year maturity to improve its debt structure and cut its reliance on Bitcoin-collateralized loans without selling holdings.

articles.title: MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
articles.description: European retailer MediaMarkt pulled Ledger products as the wallet maker probes tampering reports beyond CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia.

articles.title: UnitedHealth Group tops estimates, hikes profit outlook as insurer manages high medical costs
articles.description: UnitedHealth Group said it expects 2026 adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share, up from a previous outlook of $19.50 to $20.00 per share.

articles.title: Trump census plan to cut noncitizens from 2030 count spurs critics toward legal fight
articles.description: The Trump administration's proposal to exclude some noncitizens from the 2030 census prompts alarm for voting rights groups.

articles.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
articles.description: France opens debate on its 2027 budget as high deficits, rising debt and student protests intensify pressure on lawmakers.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
articles.description: Bitcoin’s liquidity kept BTC price below $84,000 amid a mounting South Korean tech and semiconductor stock sell-off.

articles.title: Ledger says 'spy' chip inside CryptoBilis Ledger devices transmitted wallet keys over mobile network
articles.description: The hardware-wallet maker gave its first public account of how a covert component in devices sold by CryptoBilis could steal users’ master keys without changing Ledger’s software.

articles.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
articles.description: The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.

articles.title: Trump 'not happy' with Kimberly Guilfoyle, weighs firing her as ambassador to Greece
articles.description: The former Fox News personality Guilfoyle was previously engaged to the president's son, Donald Trump Jr.

articles.title: Oil prices fall as traders assess Russian diesel supply prospects and Saudi-Houthi conflict
articles.description: Oil prices fell as investors assess potential supply disruptions against prospects of more Russian diesel entering global markets.

articles.title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
articles.description: The shutdown comes as NFT trading volumes have collapsed from their 2021-2022 peak, with market revenue projected at $318 million this year.

articles.title: French supermarket fridges get hacked, heating to 122°F and sparking fires
articles.description: Hackers targeted hundreds of French supermarkets in a large-scale cyberattack, causing refrigerators to overheat, spoiling food, and sparking fires.

articles.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
articles.description: Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.

articles.title: SpaceX agrees to testify to NYC Council about AI safety after receiving subpoena
articles.description: SpaceX has agreed to testify before the New York City Council as part of an investigation into AI safety risks.

articles.title: Micron, SoftBank and ASML slide as Wall Street chip rout spreads
articles.description: Technology stocks tumbled Tuesday as a sell-off in U.S. semiconductor shares spilled into Asian and European markets.

articles.title: Ledger details LTE-enabled spy implants in wallets sold by CryptoBilis
articles.description: Ledger detailed how LTE-enabled implants exposed wallet recovery phrases as CryptoBilis halted sales and Trezor and OneKey cut ties with the reseller.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury yields fall as energy prices pull back
articles.description: Bond yields fell on Tuesday as investors await more economic data releases this week.

articles.title: Anthropic warns AI models could soon copy themselves across home devices
articles.description: Anthropic's latest research adds to the growing safety concerns around AI from the ability for models to carry out cyberattacks to the technology going rogue.
